add_ids_to_segment.description: Add user ids (or other ids) to an ID list segment.
add_ids_to_segment.display_str_template: Add IDs to segment in Statsig.
add_ids_to_segment.name: add_ids_to_segment

parameters.description: The ID list segment.
parameters.name: segment

add_users_to_gate.description: Always let some users through a feature gate, or always keep others out, whatever its rules say. Other users already added stay.
add_users_to_gate.display_str_template: Add users to feature gate in Statsig.
add_users_to_gate.name: add_users_to_gate

parameters.description: The feature gate.
parameters.name: gate

parameters.description: User ids that always pass the gate, whatever its rules say. Type several separated by commas, or pass a list from an earlier step.
parameters.name: passing_user_ids

parameters.description: User ids that never pass the gate, whatever its rules say. Type several separated by commas, or pass a list from an earlier step.
parameters.name: failing_user_ids

failing_user_ids.description: Every user the gate now always keeps out

passing_user_ids.description: Every user the gate now always lets through

create_dynamic_config.description: Create a dynamic config that serves its default value to everyone. Add rules in Statsig to serve others something else.
create_dynamic_config.name: create_dynamic_config

parameters.description: The config's name, 3 to 100 characters. Statsig makes its id from it: Pricing Page becomes pricing_page.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: What it is for, shown in the Statsig console.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: The values the config serves to everyone, such as a button colour or a limit.
parameters.name: default_value

parameters.description: Which id it checks people by. Leave empty for User ID, Statsig's default.
parameters.name: id_type

parameters.description: Tags to file it under in the Statsig console.
parameters.name: tags

create_gate.description: Create a feature gate. It starts with no rules, so it lets through only the users you add to it; add rules in Statsig to roll it out further.
create_gate.name: create_gate

parameters.description: The gate's name, 3 to 100 characters. Statsig makes its id from it: New Checkout becomes new_checkout.

parameters.name: id_type

parameters.description: Tags to file it under in the Statsig console.
parameters.name: tags

parameters.description: Create the gate turned on. A new gate has no rules, so it lets through only the users you add to it either way.
parameters.name: is_enabled

create_segment.description: Create an ID list segment, a named list of users (or other ids) that gate and config rules can target, and optionally fill it.
create_segment.name: create_segment

parameters.description: The segment's name, 3 to 100 characters. Statsig makes its id from it: Beta Testers becomes beta_testers.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: What it is for, shown in the Statsig console.

parameters.description: Which id it checks people by. Leave empty for User ID, Statsig's default.
parameters.name: id_type
